title: Aiken data center transmission and energization evidence
scope: Public application, certificate, and April 2, 2026 utility status report. Scope, planned milestones, and reported energization are recorded separately.

certificate.selection_basis_as_reported: Santee Cooper concluded the 115 kV option required substantial facility upgrades. Testimony in the order described 230 kV service as more timely and cost-effective for the customer.

transmission_scope.distance_basis: Length stated for the Aiken No. 3 to Mt. Zion buildout, primarily along existing rights of way.
Combined line length for Central’s two feeders, as described in the order.

events_as_of_april_status_filing.date_basis: Date of letter cited in the April report, rather than exact date construction concluded.
